swe1_target.basis: Requirement Studio SWE.1 Authoring Guide V0.2
swe1_target.hierarchy: Feature > SRS > Detailed Behavior (BF retained internally)
swe1_target.srs_rule: One SRS per independently testable software requirement; SRS IDs are assigned SRS_001... after deterministic Canonical merge and reused by all SWE.1 outputs.
swe1_target.no_fabrication: Unsupported facts remain internal review flags or blank/Not Confirmed; they are not invented to complete final output.
swe1_target.traceability_view: Input Source / Requirement -> SWE.1 SRS -> SWE.6 Test Case ID
swe1_target.other_field_rule: 기타에는 Source-backed Figure/Diagram/Table/auxiliary material만 표시하며 없으면 공란으로 둔다.
swe1_target.review_view_rule: V0.80 Engineering Main preserves every Canonical Engineering Requirement, including System/native-domain/REVIEW_REQUIRED/HOLD items. 01_SWE1 remains a software-compatibility projection; SYS.1/SWE.1/native-domain decisions are visible in dedicated views and annexes.
swe1_target.no_silent_loss_rule: Review-relevant Canonical fields must be dispositioned to Final View, Review View, or explicit Internal-only status; unmapped data is EXPORT_INFORMATION_LOSS.

swe6_target.basis: Requirement Studio SWE.6 Authoring Guide V0.1
swe6_target.traceability: One requirement may derive zero, one, or many test cases.
specification_fields: Methods for Testing / Method for deriving TC
Test preparation: Description / Variable / Compare / Value
Test execution: Description / Variable / Compare / Value
Expected Result: Description / Variable / Compare / Value
swe6_target.pre_execution_rule: All four execution result fields must remain blank before test execution. N/A is allowed only in design-side Variable/Compare/Value when Source cannot concretize them.
swe6_target.test_method_rule: Requirement-based testing is the base method; boundary/equivalence/state-transition technique is selected locally from Canonical Requirement characteristics.
swe6_target.provider_independence: SWE.6 workbook derivation runs locally from Canonical Requirement and is not generated by a provider-specific SWE.6 prompt.
swe6_target.na_rule: For Test Preparation/Execution/Expected Result Variable/Compare/Value, use N/A only when the block description exists but the value cannot be derived from Source. Do not fill intentionally blank user-result fields with N/A.
swe6_target.source_fidelity_rule: Source-backed key behavior/value/prohibition facts must remain visible in TC Description/Execution/Expected Result or an explicit Deferred Intent. Do not normalize ambiguous source wording into an unsupported comparator.
swe6_target.atomicity_rule: A parent SRS may keep one draft Normal TC, but multiple source-backed atomic behaviors are exposed as child verification intents so one generic PASS cannot silently imply complete atomic coverage.
swe6_target.interface_fact_allocation_rule: Interface bitrate/NM/configuration facts require explicit software-allocation evidence before SWE.6 eligibility; otherwise defer to interface allocation review.
swe6_target.export_audit: SWE.6-specific preservation audit covers SRS/TC trace, allocation-pending deferred governance, child-intent disposition, canonical Source-fact provenance, cross-domain bundle review, and actual XLSX verification.
swe6_target.deferred_allocation_rule: SWE.6 allocation-pending requirements retain at least one auditable deferred intent with ALLOCATION_PENDING; empty deferred arrays never count as complete governance.
swe6_target.child_intent_disposition_rule: Each source-backed child intent is dispositioned as REPRESENTED_IN_GENERIC_TC, INDEPENDENTLY_COVERED, DEFERRED, or REVIEW_REQUIRED. Independent coverage requires a structured input/observation criterion relevant to that child intent.
swe6_target.cross_domain_fact_rule: Mixed non-SW facts remain one parent review bundle by default. Fact-level allocation records preserve Electrical/Environmental/Manufacturing/Mechanical verification responsibility without automatic SRS splitting.
swe6_target.derived_verification_method_rule: Verification-method candidates not stated in Source may be proposed only with knowledge_state=DERIVED and must not be represented as Source facts.
swe6_target.table_fact_value_role_rule: Source Table facts are classified as SINGLE_REQUIRED_VALUE, TIMING_CRITERION, ENUM_MAPPING, RANGE_CONSTRAINT, INVALID_MARKER, ENCODING_RULE, or SOURCE_LITERAL_ONLY. Only the first two may be auto-used in TC Variable/Compare/Value with HIGH-confidence requirement linkage.
swe6_target.source_fact_fragment_rule: Compound Semantic Source Units are split at strong sentence/list/action-clause boundaries into stable Source Fact Fragments. Table cells preserve numeric literals without prose/list splitting. Fragment ownership is determined by Canonical behavior fields, not by reusing the whole composite Source evidence.
swe6_target.unsupported_audit_scope: Unsupported-generation token audit evaluates factual assertion values only; schema keys, provenance keys, knowledge-state labels, and empty applicability containers are excluded.
swe6_target.positive_sw_allocation_rule: V0.80: SWE.6 candidate eligibility may come from explicit Source-backed SW allocation/software-structural evidence OR review-required inference when an explicit Controller/ECU actor performs literal executable software-like Source behavior. Inference is not approved allocation, cannot override high-confidence non-SW domains, and cannot justify invented facts.
swe6_target.regression_reference_rule: Regression PASS requires an explicitly approved same-source Gold Source contract or protected legacy reference. Ordinary prior/current runs never auto-promote into a baseline. no-ID Sources may use stable Source keys derived from source location + normalized fact text.
swe6_target.gate_separation_rule: Tool Quality Gate evaluates program fidelity/invariants. Artifact Readiness Gate evaluates whether the generated SWE.6 artifact is independently executable/complete given Source and external dependencies.
swe6_target.tc_maturity_rule: Each generated TC exposes TC Maturity (INTENT_DRAFT/PARTIALLY_TESTABLE/EXECUTION_READY), Independent Coverage, and Execution Readiness. Generic textual representation does not imply independent coverage.
swe6_target.child_fragment_identity_rule: Source-backed Child Intents preserve source_fact_fragment_id whenever the parent SRS owns a Source Fact Fragment; semantic-unit-only trace is a Tool Quality review finding.
swe6_target.mixed_domain_tc_scope_rule: V0.80: a generated SWE.6 TC may assert only SWE.6-eligible Fact scope. Any SYS.5/pending Fact is barred from qualifying Execution/Expected assertions unless explicitly labelled non-qualifying context. System-level facts are projected separately to SYS.5 Candidate view.
swe6_target.capture_export_contract: Column U Capture CANoe (Optional) remains part of the workbook schema. User entry is optional, but the header is required and pre-execution cells must be physically blank.

review_exchange.evaluator_core_files: No fixed file-count limit in unified mode
review_exchange.principle: Keep Source and Review Package from the same run. V0.88 recommended Unified evaluation requires legacy SWE.1/SWE.6 plus E2E Requirements Word/Excel and the complete E2E Evaluation workbook as actual artifact evidence.

outputs: automatic_evaluation/guide_person/applied_policy_snapshot.txt + .json (reused Human Policy decisions for this Run)
automatic_evaluation.consensus_rule: 3 reviewers=STRONG_CONSENSUS, 2=CONSENSUS, 1=SINGLE_REVIEWER; V0.85 also applies deterministic Unified Artifact Contract gating before Final Result. No majority vote can hide FAIL/HOLD.

human_policy_registry.merge_rule: Package seed adds missing Policy IDs only; existing local human decisions are never overwritten.
human_policy_registry.repeat_question_rule: YES/NO/CONDITIONAL resolved policies are reused; DEFER/new families remain GUIDE_PERSON questions.
human_policy_registry.review_preservation_rule: REVIEW_REQUIRED/HOLD requirements remain visible in Main Requirement Specification and Review View; visibility does not imply Official Release approval.

principles: Visibility never implies Official Release approval
engineering_e2e.mixed_domain_rule: Keep parent Canonical for source context; allocate/verify at Fact level and project only qualifying facts to each domain view. Other facts stay visible in Review/Allocation context.
engineering_e2e.sys5_candidate_rule: System-level Source-backed facts may create SYS.5 Candidate intents even when not SWE.6. Candidate result/PASS-FAIL fields stay blank and readiness stays REVIEW_REQUIRED until approved/executed.
engineering_e2e.proposed_change_rule: Source proposal/change-pending interface facts remain explicitly PROPOSED_CHANGE_PENDING or review-required until the source/owner resolves the authoritative interface.
engineering_e2e.compatibility_naming: Legacy SWE.1/SWE.6 filenames are retained temporarily for downstream compatibility; internal titles/sheets are Engineering E2E integrated views and are not an ASPICE conformance claim.
engineering_e2e.ownership_consistency_rule: V0.82 retains V0.81 clear cross-SRS ownership repair and recomputes allocation after cleanup.
engineering_e2e.swe6_parent_fact_consistency_rule: V0.82 retains V0.81 parent/fact consistency and additionally requires every non-generated Source-backed verification intent to remain visible in the integrated test specification.

integrated_outputs.requirements_scope: Canonical Engineering Requirement + SYS.1/SWE.1/native-domain projection + Source/fact allocation trace
integrated_outputs.tests_scope: SYS.5 Candidate + SWE.6 TC + Deferred/Allocation Pending/External Dependency/native verification intents
